node.title: Haboeck's proved quadratic Johnson-range MCA theorem
node.closure: published theorem import with proof and convention audit
node.statement: For C={eval_D(p):deg(p)<=d}, rho=d/n, and every integer m>=3, Haboeck Theorem 2 bounds the finite-affine same-support MCA exceptional-slope set at gamma=1-(1+1/(2m))sqrt(rho) by (ell^7/3)(rho*n)^2, where ell=(m+1/2)/sqrt(rho). In repository dimension convention K this uses d=K-1 and rho=(K-1)/n. Only the proved quadratic bound is imported; the BCHKS25 linear refinement and higher-degree samplers are not claimed.
